title: Cross-Scale Empirical Invariance of Procedural Fractal Pedagogy
description: Comparative phase-space analysis across K-12 Mathematics (ASSISTments) and Higher Education (OULAD).

synthesis.scale_invariance_proof: The Mandelbrot cardioid boundary (locus 0.25 +/- 0.18i) maintains bounded pedagogical stability across both micro-scale item scaffolding (ASSISTments, p < 0.001) and macro-scale semester persistence (OULAD, p < 0.001).
